assertion.rationale: F1: data-api's middleware chain has a readOnlyGuard but no authentication layer in front of it, so external ingress meant any caller could execute any exposed transaction (feed reads, table scans) without being limited to a permitted set. F1 is now CLOSED (Task 6): infra/bicep/apps/main.bicep's dataApiApp module sets ingressExternal:false, so data-api's transactions are reachable only through the server-side nginx proxy inside the Container Apps environment — both frontends' nginx.conf.template already carried the /api/ proxy rule, verified present in both, so this closes the gap without adding a token to distribute or rotate. F13: zero workload RBAC exists in IaC — there is no principal-scoped restriction on which transactions or functions each workload identity may perform; the only grants that exist are subscription-scoped Owner (deployer) and Reader (verifier), an all-or-nothing shape with no per-function limitation for data-api, mcp-tools or cost-ingest. Task 12 expresses five of the seven documented grants in code — data-api and mcp-tools each get Log Analytics Reader (LAW scope) and Security Reader (subscription scope), mcp-tools gets Cost Management Reader, data-api's SQL contained-database user and Fabric workspace Viewer grants are expressed in data/seed/sql/900-contained-users.sql and infra/fabric/provision-workspace.ps1 respectively — scoped per transaction rather than left at the all-or-nothing Owner/Reader shape. Task 17 (F15, now CLOSED) expresses the sixth: layer-06-platform.yml now creates the cost export via `az rest` against the Exports REST API (api-version 2023-08-01) with an explicit `identity: { type: SystemAssigned }` request in the PUT body — the `az costmanagement` CLI extension has neither an --identity-type flag nor, at its pinned API version, any support for RBAC-only storage (it hard-requires shared keys, github.com/Azure/azure-cli/issues/32912) — and grants that identity's principalId Storage Blob Data Contributor, scoped to the cost-exports container, once the PUT response returns it. F13 is NOT fully closed: cost-ingest's Storage Blob Data Reader grant is blocked on F19 (cost-ingest has no Function App or identity anywhere in this repo's IaC). Overall status stays GAP: F1 is closed, and F13 is six-sevenths expressed, but the one remaining grant means transactions for cost-ingest are still not limited to authorized processes by construction.

recommendation: Close the one remaining grant: F19 (provision cost-ingest as a real Function App with an identity) before its Storage Blob Data Reader grant can exist at all. (Setting ingressExternal:false on data-api is DONE — Task 6. Six of the seven documented workload RBAC grants, scoped to the specific transactions each principal needs, are DONE — Tasks 12 and 17.)
